name: size-fixture
description: Install-only fixture for scripts/size-baseline.mjs. NOT a workspace member (tests/ is outside the pnpm-workspace globs). Mirrors the measured scenario: a minimal Astro site depending on astro + tinacms + @tinacms/cli, installed with npm against a throwaway verdaccio registry.
_overrides_comment: The committed lockfile is a manifest like any other to dependency-review, so a vulnerable transitive here fails the PR even though nothing in this fixture is ever executed — it is installed and measured with du. brace-expansion is patched only in 5.0.8 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg covers <= 5.0.7), which is a major jump from the ^2.0.1 its parent asks for. Safe here, but it does mean the measured tree carries one dependency a real user's install would not; it is a few KB against a ~1 GB closure. Drop the override once the upstream range moves.
